title: Contoso Private Equity Secondaries IV — Q1 2026 update
content: Vintage 2018, currently in mid-life harvest phase. Two large distributions completed in Q1; capital-call schedule is now light through end-2026. Trailing IRR 14.2%; TVPI 1.62x. Valuation lag remains ~90 days. Manager has flagged that secondary-market discounts have narrowed materially in Europe; selling secondaries now is more attractive than 12 months ago. Concentration: top-10 underlying funds account for 42% of NAV. Recommended action for clients above 25% PE allocation: consider tactical secondary sale rather than a primary mark-down.
